newsitem.title: USA: EMC seen as undervalued - Business Week.
newsitem.headline: EMC seen as undervalued - Business Week.

text.p: EMC Corp, which makes information, storage and retrieval products, is "still undervalued," an investment manager said in Business Week magazine.
Bill Harnisch, president of investment firm Forstmann-Leff Associates, told Business Week he expects the stock price to double in price within the next six to 12 months.
EMC closed Wednesday at $30 a share.
Harnisch's firm owns 6.6 million shares or 2 percent of EMC's outstanding stock, the magazine said.
Harnisch also expects EMC to earn $2-$2.20 a share in 1997.
EMC said in October said it was on track for 1996 revenue and earnings per share growth of more than 25 percent over last year.
In 1995, EMC earned $62.1 million after charges or $0.26 a share.
EMC was not available to comment on the Business Week report.
